decisions.reason: Certified HVAC plate exchanger models sit close to the established offer, so keeping them costs little, and one year of only a website mention leaves the option's value unresolved.
The box cooler line shows a positive early signal of high quality and a major market share in water cooling, so the option is in the money and worth keeping.
The marine cooling unit has its own page and builds on the firm's marine base, so carrying it costs little while its uncertain value has had no time to resolve.
The compact oil cooler line uses existing capabilities and carries little cost, and nothing yet shows its value will fail to materialize.
Finned tubes are a component built on core know-how, so they are cheap to keep and the option stays open while the results remain uncertain.
Enhanced tubes have a dedicated page and grow out of the firm's own R&D, so the low carrying cost and unresolved potential justify keeping them.
